hardwareHubs.note: TinkerMill describes itself as the largest makerspace in Colorado and the Rocky Mountain region.
Innosphere, a science and technology startup accelerator with lab space, is headquartered here.

makerspaces.name: TinkerMill
makerspaces.note: Nonprofit makerspace with a 4kW laser, machine shop, rapid prototyping, woodshop, and electronics and robotics shops.

makerspaces.name: denhac
makerspaces.note: Denver hackerspace that its Meetup listing says has 3D printers, laser cutters, a woodshop, welders and CNC.

programs.name: Innosphere
programs.note: Accelerator for science and technology startups offering dry lab and office space and a focus on advanced industries.

specialties.name: Aerospace
specialties.note: Colorado ranks first per capita in aerospace employment and hosts U.S. Space Command, with United Launch Alliance and Lockheed Martin Space active.

specialties.name: Advanced manufacturing
specialties.note: A state industry profile cites 5,600 companies and 143,000 employees, though the figures are older.

support.name: Manufacturer's Edge
support.note: Colorado's NIST MEP center, offering onsite support, training and technical assistance from offices in Westminster, Loveland and Lakewood.
